text: I need a 4:5 night market flyer, dark blue with warm lanterns. Exactly four separate text blocks, top to bottom: 'NIGHT MARKET', '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00', 'Old Mill Courtyard', 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'. Leave clear space between the blocks; don't add any other words.

change.say: actually, make it square and keep everything else exactly the same.
